question: In which year was the Gandhi-Irwin Pact signed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1931**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Gandhi-Irwin Pact** was signed in the year **1931**.
 
• This pact was an agreement between **Mahatma Gandhi **and the then **Viceroy of India, Lord Irwin.**
